text:
Maria (People Ops): Quick heads up — noticed a cluster of interviewers marked as 'cert expired' even though they completed Recurring Interviewer Cert in LMS last week. This is blocking assignment for two hiring funnels. Anyone else seeing stale cert status?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I saw one case — the ATS looks up cert_valid_until from the user_profile table which should be updated via the LMS webhook. Webhook logs show delivered but ATS reports certificate_missing for those users.
Priya (Learning): LMS shows completions and the renewal badge on the learner dashboard. We sent webhook payloads on schedule. Sample payload: user_email=tara@company.com, course=Recurring Interviewer Cert, status=completed, expires_at=2027-03-22T00:00:00Z.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Our ingestion service expects expires_at and sets user_profile.cert_valid_until. But I found that for orgs using the legacy user import flow, user_profile rows are created after LMS webhooks, causing a null write to be ignored. There's no retry currently.
Lee (Recruiter): Two panels tonight are blocked because interviewers show up as 'not certified' in scheduler. Can we do a manual override?
Maria (People Ops): Manual override ok for immediate hires, but we should fix root cause. Priya, can you requeue the webhooks for affected emails? Sam, can you add a short-runback to the ingestion to retry on missing user_profile?
Priya (Learning): Requeued webhooks for tara@company.com and josh@company.com now. Also emailing learners to confirm they used corporate email.
onboarding-bot: webhook.requeue payloads=2 users=["tara@company.com","josh@company.com"]
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I'll push a small ingestion patch to buffer writes and retry after 5s if user_profile not found. Low-risk, can deploy in 15m. Also filing ticket REQ-4567 to make training webhook idempotent and add a verification step in org provisioning to pre-create user_profile rows for expected users.
Priya (Learning): Thanks — once replays run, please confirm and I'll update training docs with a note to prefer corporate emails.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Patch deployed. Replayed webhooks processed successfully; cert_valid_until set for both users. Verified scheduler can assign them to interviews.
Lee (Recruiter): Confirmed Tara and Josh assigned to panels. Thanks!
Maria (People Ops): Action items: Sam deploys ingestion retry (done), Sam files REQ-4567, Priya updates training signup copy, Maria to add a checklist step in hiring ops runbook to verify cert status post-onboarding. Closing once runbook updated.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Ticket filed and runbook step added to Hiring Ops checklist. Moving thread to resolved.
Priya (Learning): Training docs updated. Closing. :white_check_mark:
